# LumAIa – The Agentic Agency Platform for Marketing

> LumAIa automates the entire marketing workflow – from strategy to campaign optimization.
> 10x faster, 70% cheaper, 100% brand-safe.

## About

LumAIa is an AI-powered platform that unifies strategy, production, and campaign optimization in one system. It translates the expertise of a top agency into software, delivering 10x faster campaigns, 70% lower costs, and 100% brand safety.

## Company

- Name: LumAIa (by iundf Dewave AG)
- Website: https://lumaia.studio
- Location: Switzerland
- Contact: hello@lumaia.ai

## Platform Phases

1. **Plan** – Market analysis, personas, media strategy, budget planning
2. **Build** – Asset creation (banners, copy, visuals, landing pages, emails)
3. **Publish** – Automated campaign launch, budget control, real-time optimization
4. **Report & Learn** – Attribution, management reports, learning feedback loop

## Key Modules

- Briefing Agent
- Market & Audience Intelligence Agent
- Persona Architect
- Media Strategy Agent
- Media Planning Agent
- Production Planning Agent
- Creative Concept & Key Visual Agent
- Media Asset Studio
- Landing Page Agent
- Email Agent
- Content & Copy Agent
- Product Asset Studio (live – for e-commerce image assets)
- Campaign Activation Agent
- Autonomous Optimization Agent
- Campaign Health Monitor
- Attribution AI
- Executive Dashboard Agent
- Learning Engine
- GEO Visibility & Performance Monitor

## Product Asset Studio

Turns a single product image into a complete set of hero, lifestyle, detail, and micro-rotation assets – EU AI Act compliant with C2PA provenance records and Fidelity Scoring.

## Use Cases

- Agentic Commerce: Making online shops agent-ready for AI shopping agents
- Product launches at record speed
- ROAS maximization during sales events
- Regional campaign scaling
- AEO dominance

## Pricing

- Self-Serve: From CHF 29/month (e.g., Product Asset Studio)
- Pilot Partner: 12-month fixed price with full module access
